service.description: The questions of the quiz of a module, without correct answers.
Score the answers of a module quiz and keep the best score in the progress of the user. Returns per question whether it was right, the right answer and the explanation.

actions.script: int correctCount = 0 results = [] questionList.eachWithIndex { q, int i -> def answer = i < answers.size() ? answers[i] : null boolean correct = answer != null && (answer as Integer) == (q.correctIndex as Integer) if (correct) correctCount++ results.add([questionId: q.questionId, correct: correct, correctIndex: q.correctIndex, explanation: q.explanation]) } scorePercent = (int) Math.round(correctCount * 100.0 / questionList.size()) passed = scorePercent >= 70 weakLessonIds = [] questionList.eachWithIndex { q, int i -> if (!results[i].correct && q.lessonId && !(q.lessonId in weakLessonIds)) weakLessonIds.add(q.lessonId) }

def scores = progressEntity?.quizScores ? new groovy.json.JsonSlurper().parseText(progressEntity.quizScores as String) as Map : [:] scores[moduleId] = Math.max((scores[moduleId] ?: 0) as int, scorePercent) context.quizScoresJson = groovy.json.JsonOutput.toJson(scores)

service-call.name: create#growerp.course.CourseProgress
service-call.in-map: [userId: ec.user.userId, courseId: courseId, completedLessons: '[]', progressPercent: 0, quizScores: quizScoresJson, startedDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp, lastAccessDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

service.description: What the learner best does next, from the progress, the quiz scores and the weak spots; the AI explains why. Without AI: the next lesson not done yet.

actions.script: int optionCount = new groovy.json.JsonSlurper().parseText(questionEntity.optionsJson ?: '[]').size() if (questionEntity.correctIndex == null || questionEntity.correctIndex < 0 || questionEntity.correctIndex >= optionCount) ec.message.addError("The correct answer must be one of the options")
